# vaultK Note Update

Modify existing notes without breaking structure or conventions.

## Workflow

1. Locate note:
   - filename or keyword search
   - active folders first
   - then archive

2. Read fully:
   - frontmatter
   - structure
   - links
   - category (knowledge/project/area/resource)

3. Scan related notes:
   - find cross-link candidates
   - detect structural issues
   - check archive relevance

4. Update content:
   - append, don’t overwrite
   - keep sections intact
   - match style

5. Update metadata:
   - tags
   - related
   - concepts
   - status (only if needed)

6. Link connections:
   - add wikilinks or frontmatter links
   - keep edits minimal

## Decomposition (only if needed)

Split note if:
- mixes knowledge + execution
- grows too broad
- contains extractable concept

## Archive handling

- prefer reactivation over duplication
- preserve history

## Rules

- never delete content by default
- always additive
- preserve structure + templates
- avoid unnecessary refactors
- stay consistent with vault conventions
